checks.title: Setting on and off
checks.check: If the change depends on a setting or option, check the result with the setting on and with it off, and confirm the off state keeps the old behavior.
checks.applies_when: A setting, option or config key controls the behavior.

checks.title: UUID and path-based repositories
checks.check: Check the result on a UUID-enabled repository and on a path-based one, including references created before the change.
checks.applies_when: The behavior touches file identity, references or file names.
checks.exclude_when: Pure UI styling with no stored reference.

checks.title: Earlier choices are kept
checks.check: Go back and forth in the dialog or wizard, and close and reopen it: earlier selections and values must stay as the user set them.
checks.applies_when: A multi-step dialog, wizard, panel or saved selection is involved.
checks.exclude_when: Single-click actions with no stored choice.

checks.title: Failure keeps the previous state
checks.check: Make the operation fail part-way (system error, post-processing failure): the previous configuration or content must stay unchanged, and the user sees an error.
checks.applies_when: The operation writes or replaces saved configuration or content.

checks.title: Same result from every entry path
checks.check: Do the action from the toolbar, the context menu, the keyboard shortcut and drag-and-drop where available: each path must give the same result.
checks.applies_when: The action is reachable from more than one place in the Editor.

checks.title: Paste of content that is not allowed
checks.check: Paste content that is not allowed at the cursor position: it must fall back to allowed content or plain text, with no <foreign>, <draft-comment> or extra wrapper elements.
checks.applies_when: The change is about copy, cut or paste in the Editor.

checks.title: Undo and redo after the action
checks.check: After the action, use Undo and Redo: the content must return to the earlier state and back, without bringing back the defect.
checks.applies_when: The action edits content in the Editor.
checks.exclude_when: Actions that do not change content.

checks.title: Author and Source view agree, also after save and reopen
checks.check: Check the result in Author view and Source view, then save, close and reopen the file: both views must show the same structure and nothing extra is added.
checks.applies_when: The action changes document structure or attributes.

checks.title: Dialogs and controls stay usable
checks.check: Open the dialog or panel at a high zoom level and small window size: all fields and buttons must be visible and usable (scroll bar where needed).
checks.applies_when: The change adds or changes a dialog, panel or control.

checks.title: Reference written in the right form
checks.check: Insert a reference from the toolbar, the browse dialog and drag-and-drop from the Repository panel, then check Source view: the reference must use the expected form (UUID or path) in every case.
checks.applies_when: The action creates or updates a reference (xref, topicref, image, conref, key).

checks.title: Move or rename keeps references working
checks.check: Move or rename the referenced file or its folder: every place that uses it must still resolve, and reports must show the new location.
checks.applies_when: Files that are referenced elsewhere can be moved or renamed.

checks.title: Both sides of the relation are updated
checks.check: Check the other side of the relation: where-used / used-in lists, reports, baselines and translation copies must reflect the change.
checks.applies_when: The change affects a link between two assets.

checks.title: Inherited values follow the parent
checks.check: When a value can come from a parent map (for example Use map properties as fallback), check the child topic both with and without its own value.
checks.applies_when: Values can be inherited from a parent map or folder.

checks.title: New version keeps label and comment
checks.check: Save as a new version with a label and a comment: Version History must show them, and the previous version stays unchanged.
checks.applies_when: The action creates or changes file versions.

checks.title: Baselines survive later changes
checks.check: After creating a baseline, move, rename, delete or update files in it: the baseline must still resolve, show broken links where expected, and keep its selection.
checks.applies_when: Baselines, publishing or translation use the affected content.
checks.exclude_when: Content never used in a baseline.

checks.title: Create version on upload, on and off
checks.check: Upload files with the create-version option on and off: versions are created only when it is on, and aborted uploads change nothing.
checks.applies_when: Files can be uploaded or replaced.

checks.title: Content made before the upgrade
checks.check: Open, edit and publish content created on the previous release: it must keep working without manual migration.
checks.applies_when: Existing customer content predates the change.
checks.exclude_when: Brand-new feature with no old data.

checks.title: UI and API give the same result
checks.check: Do the same operation through the UI and through the API: the result, file path and stored properties must match.
checks.applies_when: The operation is also available as an API or servlet.

checks.title: Response still has everything callers use
checks.check: Check the API response: fields that reports and integrations used before must still be there with the same meaning.
checks.applies_when: An API response shape or endpoint changes.

checks.title: Blocked or invalid request is refused cleanly
checks.check: Send a request the change should block (for example a rename that is not allowed): the API must refuse it with a clear error and change nothing.
checks.applies_when: The change adds a restriction or validation.

checks.title: Every upload and creation route
checks.check: Repeat with each way content enters the repository that applies: Editor, API, desktop tool, Oxygen, package or zip upload.
checks.applies_when: Content can be created or updated by more than one route.
checks.trigger: \b(oxygen|zip upload|zip extract|package manager|pkgmgr|crx package|desktop (tool|app)|webdav|assets api|upload api)\b
